description: This file contains functions for managing system paths related to content directories and CA certificates within the starboard common namespace, including path retrieval and concatenation utilities.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPathFromSubdir
methods.description: Constructs the path to CA certificates based on a subdirectory within the content directory.

methods.name: PrependContentPath
methods.description: Prepends the content directory path to a given relative path.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPath
methods.description: Retrieves the CA certificates path, trying a specific subdirectory and falling back if necessary.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPath
methods.description: Retrieves the CA certificates path, with default subdirectory logic.
